sources.title: distil-labs/distil-qwen3-0.6b-SHELLper · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A fine-tuned Qwen3-0.6B model for multi-turn bash function calling. Trained using knowledge distillation from Qwen3-235B, this 0.6B parameter model achieves 100% tool-call accuracy on our test set over multiple turns while being small enough to run locally on any machine.

sources.title: SHELLper: Multi-turn Bash Function Calling Model - distil labs
sources.snippet: Our model converts plain text requests into executable bash commands. Multi-turn tool calling is notoriously difficult for small models - before tuning, QWEN3 0.6B had a single tool call prediction accuracy of 84% which means accuracy of 42% for 5-turn user-model conversations!

sources.title: GitHub - distil-labs/distil-voice-assistant-banking: Local banking ...
sources.snippet: We fine-tuned a Qwen3-0.6B model to handle multi-turn tool calling for banking customer service. It classifies intents and extracts slots as structured function calls, running at ~40ms vs 375-750ms for cloud LLMs. Combined with local ASR and TTS, the full voice pipeline runs under 400ms, well within the 500-800ms threshold for natural conversation.
